title: Wi-Fi Connection Issues
content: Check that Wi-Fi is enabled. Restart the network adapter and reconnect to the correct wireless network.

title: Outlook Email Not Syncing
content: Check your internet connection. Restart Outlook and verify the account settings. Contact IT support if synchronization still fails.

title: Password Reset Problems
content: Verify your username and follow the approved password reset process. Contact the help desk if the reset link has expired.

title: Application Crashing
content: Save your work if possible. Restart the application and check for available updates. Contact IT support if the application continues to crash.

title: Printer Showing Offline
content: Check that the printer is powered on and connected to the network. Verify the selected printer and clear any stuck print jobs.

title: VPN Connection Failure
content: Verify your internet connection and VPN credentials. Restart the VPN client and reconnect. Contact IT support if the connection fails repeatedly.

title: Computer Running Slowly
content: Close unnecessary applications and check available disk space. Restart the computer and contact IT support if performance remains poor.

title: Audio Not Working
content: Check the volume level and confirm the correct audio output device is selected. Reconnect the headset and test the audio again.
